senses.gloss: הִזִּיק (denom. of נֵזֶק) to hurt, injure, damage.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 20">Ex. R. s. 20</cite>, beg. <he>דלג … ולא הִזִּיקוֹ</he> stepped over the child and did not injure it.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 1:1">B. Kam. I, 1</cite> <he>לילך ולהַזִּיק</he> to do injury in moving (be an active agency of damage); <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 1:1">ib.</cite> <he>וכשה׳ חב וכ׳</he> and when one of them caused damage, the offender (<cite ref="M00757"><he>מַזִּיק</he></cite>) is responsible. Ib. III, 6 <he>והִזִּיקוּ זה וכ׳</he> and hurt one another (by collision); a. fr.—V. <cite ref="M00757"><he>מַזִּיק</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be hurt, injured, damaged. Ib. III, 1, sq. Ib. 31ᵇ שהוּזְּקוּ כלים בכלים vessels (belonging to one person) were damaged by collision with (another person’s) vessels; a. fr.
<cite ref="N00458">same</cite>. Ex. R. l. c. end <he>שלא יִנָּזְקוּ</he> that they be not hurt (by the wolves).
units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 7:10">Deut. R. s. 7</cite> <he>ולא תִנָּזֵק צפורנו של אחד מהם</he> rather than a nail of one of them be injured; a. e.—Usu. part. <he>נִיזּוֹק</he>, <he>נִזּוֹק</he>; pl. <he>נִיזּוֹקִים</he>, <he>נִיזּוֹקִין</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 9b:16">Ber. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>אינו נ׳ כל וכ׳</he> has no evil to fear for the entire day.
<cite ref="Berakhot 40a:4">Ib. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>ואי אתה נ׳</he> and thou shalt not get sick; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Chullin 142a:7">Ḥull. 142ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 8b:4">Pes. 8ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>שלוחי מצוה אינן נ׳</he> those going on a religious mission will not meet with evil; a. e.—V. <cite ref="N00641"><he>נִיזָּק</he></cite>.
